title: Eric R NDE 13213
content: I went to a scheduled an appointment for a sleep study. During the appointment. I was sick, so the technician dismissed me. My girlfriend, at the time, picked me up and I told her to get me to the nearest hospital because I'm having a stroke. We arrived at the emergency room. While filling out paperwork, I went unconscious and fell to the floor. I was in a coma for 101 days and my medical record says that I coded twice. During one of the code events, I could see the medical team working and trying to revive me. I remember walking through walls and feeling like I was going to suffocate. I heard the doctors tell my family member to take me off life support. Before I suddenly woke up in my body, something told me, 'You are OK now.' The nurse dropped her cellphone as I tried to get out of the hospital bed. I did have left-side paralysis initially. But after months of intense physical therapy, I was able to walk, talk, and function normally. My purpose to be here is to teach and help others. I created a non-profit as part of my soul purpose. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 6-10-2018 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Illness Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function). Stroke How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I heard the doctors. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal, I knew I was having a stroke At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? During one of the code events. Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Always alert Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. No hearing Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Uncertain. I was walking through walls Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes bright lights Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. Just walking through walls at locations What emotions did you feel during the experience? I was asking that they didn't disconnect me from life support Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life. I was sent back after my body was healed God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Other Christian Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Christian- Other Christian Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. God sent me back with a purpose Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin. I saw different shadows and figures Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Uncertain. I was thrown back suddenly, it was not a slow wakeup Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? Yes help others During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Yes Help others. I didn't understand for a while. I started a non-profit to help disabled people Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life’s difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Moderate changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes in my NDE book Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes I have read stories What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? none dnt8d6v_nde
